module.name: Quali-D Connect
module.description: Allow call center agents to receive FreePBX calls from anywhere in the world — including countries where SIP port 5060 is blocked (e.g. Egypt) — via the QUALI-D cloud SIP relay. All traffic runs over port 443. Simply enter your QUALI-D API key and the module configures everything automatically: SIP trunk, dialplan rules, and agent credentials.
module.changelog: 1.0.99: WireGuard two-phase setup: Phase 1 (qualid_prepare_wireguard) runs during Connect as asterisk — generates keypair via wg binary or PHP sodium fallback, registers with VPS relay; Phase 2 (qualid_apply_wireguard_config) runs in genConfig() as root on Apply Config — installs wireguard-tools, writes /etc/wireguard/wg0.conf, adds sudoers entry, starts wg-quick@wg0 1.0.97: WireGuard auto-install: move wireguard-tools installation and /etc/wireguard/ setup into install.php (runs as root via fwconsole) so Connect no longer fails when the web user lacks package manager access; add sudoers entry for asterisk user to manage wg-quick@wg0 without root at runtime 1.0.90: Fix relay TLS handshake: use hostname in PJSIP AOR contact (not raw IP) so Asterisk sends correct TLS SNI to Kamailio — fixes "unexpected message (sni: unknown)" rejection; pin hostname to VPS IP in /etc/hosts so Asterisk resolves it even when ISP DNS blocks .xyz TLD; add method=tlsv1_2 to transport; add explicit exten => h,1,Hangup() to qualid-remote-agents context 1.0.88: Fix queue agent routing: use qualid-remote-agents context for queue members so calls are routed through the relay trunk instead of attempting a direct PJSIP registration lookup — fixes CHANUNAVAIL when agents are connected via the relay app 1.0.85: Add ivr_collect_input IVR node — plays a prompt and collects multiple DTMF digits (e.g. phone numbers) storing them in a named session variable for use in downstream flow nodes 1.0.84: Also check Grandstream X-ATA-CallerID SIP header for FSK-detected caller number — fixes caller ID when HT813 FXO gateway relays PSTN CID via its proprietary header instead of P-Asserted-Identity 1.0.83: Regenerate Asterisk dialplan and PJSIP config on every Apply Config — dialplan fixes in future module updates now take effect immediately without requiring a manual reconnect 1.0.81: Fix FXO caller ID: read real PSTN caller number from P-Asserted-Identity / Remote-Party-ID SIP headers before AGI runs — fixes {{caller_id}} returning "WE-Landline-FXO" instead of the actual caller number when using a Grandstream HT813 FXO gateway 1.0.75: Fix [qualid-ivr] dialplan: add explicit exten => h,1,Hangup() so the h hangup extension does not match the _. wildcard and re-launch the AGI script on every call end 1.0.73: Fix AGI audio playback: add X-AGI-Secret header to download_audio() so audio files can be fetched from the protected /api/ivr/agi/audio/{id} endpoint; replace GET DATA (requires format_mp3) with MP3Player + WAIT FOR DIGIT for universal MP3 support; fix WAIT FOR DIGIT ASCII parsing (chr() conversion) 1.0.72: Add [qualid-ivr] dialplan context so inbound DIDs can be routed to the Quali-D IVR flow engine via AGI(qualid_ivr.php); configure via FreePBX Custom Destination pointing to qualid-ivr,<DID>,1 1.0.71: Fix TLS cap: use CURL_SSLVERSION_MAX_TLSv1_2 to force TLS 1.2 as both min and max — CURL_SSLVERSION_TLSv1_2 alone only sets the minimum, still allowing TLS 1.3 which times out on Cloudflare Tunnel + OpenSSL 3.0.x 1.0.69: Force TLS 1.2 on all relay curl calls — fixes TLS 1.3 handshake timeout with Cloudflare Tunnel on OpenSSL 3.0.x (Debian 12) 1.0.49: Fix BMO class: call parent::__construct() so FreePBX registers the module and fires generate_config(); add try/catch and last_apply_config_at diagnostic 1.0.47: Add BMO class (Qualid_remote.class.php) so generate_config() fires on every Apply Config 1.0.45: Replace AJAX page-load sync with synchronous PHP call — guaranteed to run on every page visit 1.0.43: Sync extensions + CDR immediately on every login, not just on install 1.0.41: Fix page-load sync URL bug (htmlspecialchars broke & in JS); add immediate sync on module upgrade 1.0.39: Replace cron with generate_config hook + page-load sync; use FreePBX devices table instead of ps_endpoints 1.0.38: Auto-sync CDR and extension status every 2 minutes via cron — no manual sync needed 1.0.15: Switch FreePBX→Kamailio trunk to SIP/TLS on port 443; add upgrade auto-regen of pjsip config; fix uninstall JSON cleanup 1.0.9: Fix AJAX response contaminated by FreePBX HTML banners (ob_end_clean before JSON output) 1.0.8: Replace API key with phone+password login, Turnstile, TOTP, agent_code as SIP credentials 1.0.7: Use pjsip_custom_post.conf for PJSIP include (survives FreePBX reload) 1.0.6: Fix AJAX parameter conflict with FreePBX reserved action parameter 1.0.5: Replace getConfig/setConfig with JSON file storage for full compatibility 1.0.4: Replace all PHP 7 null coalescing operators for PHP 5.6 compatibility 1.0.3: Remove getConfig calls from install.php for PHP 5.6 compatibility 1.0.2: Fix changelog format for FreePBX 15 1.0.1: Update server URLs to production deployment 1.0.0: Initial release — auto-provisioning, agent management, WSS trunk
